# Sources & Further Reading {.unnumbered}

This book is nearly entirely sourced from the notes and writing of
[Casey Handmer](https://x.com/CJHandmer).

## Primary sources

- **Casey Handmer, *Think Like A Physicist*.** The original notes and
  first chapters that this book is built from.
- **International Physics Olympiad — Australian training program.**
  Handwritten training notes from the intensive two-week program held in
  Canberra, c. 2005, which form the basis of most chapters.

## Further reading

- Casey Handmer, ["In Space, No One Can Reason By
  Analogy"](https://caseyhandmer.wordpress.com/2019/10/15/in-space-no-one-can-reason-by-analogy/)
  — on first-principles thinking.
- [Casey Handmer's blog](https://caseyhandmer.wordpress.com/) — essays on
  physics, engineering, and building the future.
